name: switchboard
description: Your other Claude Code sessions as cards above the prompt: a status lamp, a short label, what just happened, and one press to answer or jump there.

window_hours.title: Hours of history
window_hours.description: Show sessions active within this many hours. Running sessions always show.

max_cards.title: Maximum cards
max_cards.description: How many session cards the band shows at most.

summarize.title: Short labels
summarize.description: Let a small model write the short label and status line on each card. Off, the card shows the session title and the latest reply cut short.

model.title: Label model
model.description: Model alias or id for the short labels.
